posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Cubs are going to need more from Shota Imanaga down the stretch and they didn't get it today. Imanaga is done after 2+ IP & 72 pitches, allowing 5 H, including HR, 2 BB & 4 K. He departs with 2 runners on as Civale takes over. Shortest start of Imanaga's career. Counsell isn't messing around.
posts.jp: カブスは終盤、今永昇太からもっと必要としていたが、今日は得られなかった。今永昇太は2回以上で72球、5安打(本塁打含む)、2四死球、4奪三振で終了。キャリア最短の先発となり、シヴァレが後を引き継ぐ。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Crow-Armstrong came within a foot of game-tying HR & settles for 2B off top of RF wall. However he then gets doubled up on Suzuki grounder to 3B when indecisive about trying to advance on the throw. But Bregman and Busch follow with back-to-back homers off Anderson to give Cubs a 3-2 lead in 6th.
posts.jp: クロウ・アームストロングは同点本塁打まであと1フィートに迫ったが、二塁打で終わる。しかし遊撃手のゴロで進塁を迷ったため併殺に。その後ベルグマンとブッシュがアンダーソンから連続本塁打を放ち、カブスが6回に3-2でリード。

posts.author: Jeff Fletcher
posts.text: Yusei Kikuchi made too many mistakes, especially with two strikes. The hitters came up short in their comeback. www.ocregister.com/2026/08/23/s...
posts.jp: 菊池雄星は特に2ストライクの状況で多くのミスを犯した。打者たちは追い上げに失敗した。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: The Phillies, comatose for eight innings, just won their ninth straight game by scoring six runs in the ninth inning. Kyle Schwarber hits their first walk-off homer in more than three years. What in the absolute hell.

reply_texts.text: They're calling it the most normal baseball team of all time
reply_texts.author: crookedknight.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Looking forward to the Phillies v Red Sox World Series.
reply_texts.author: fava.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: You can’t write this stuff. What an amazing inning!
reply_texts.author: markrothbardt.bsky.social

posts.jp: フィリーズは8回の間無得点だったが、9回に6点を奪って9連勝。カイル・シュワーバーが3年以上ぶりの満塁本塁打を放つ。一体全体どうなってるんだ。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: I’m confident that, someday, I will write a story about Dylan Cease throwing the first #BlueJays no-hitter in my lifetime. Until then, another story about his spectacular season: www.mlb.com/bluejays/new...
posts.jp: いつかダイラン・シーズがブルージェイズ初のノーヒッターを投げる話を書くと確信している。それまでの間、彼の素晴らしいシーズンについての別の話。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: The Phillies have won eight straight. Ten days ago, they were 9 1/2 back of Braves. They now trail Atlanta by 3 games for the NL East lead.
posts.jp: フィリーズは8連勝。10日前はブレーブスに9.5ゲーム差だったが、現在NL東地区首位までアトランタから3ゲーム差。
